A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.  
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8

photos.alt: A photo of a magpie walking on the short grass. It has one leg up while doing a step. Sun is shining, and there can be a tree trunk’s shadow visible on the grass. Most of the grass is out of focus, but there are occasional yellow flowers visible here and there.
